findings.description: As the man raises the white-and-blue toothbrush from his mouth to his eyebrow and hair (00:02-00:03), the object morphs into a dark grey/black comb-like tool used to brush his hair, then transforms back into a white-and-blue toothbrush as he lowers his hand back toward his mouth at 00:04-00:05.

From 00:05 to 00:09, the toothbrush's position and orientation in the man's hand do not match its reflection: in the direct foreground view the toothbrush is held vertically below his chin and then several inches away from his face, whereas in the mirror reflection it is angled diagonally and pressed directly against his upper lip and cheek.
